articles.title: Eight Months, 3,856 Orbits: NASA Astronaut Returns from Critical ISS Mission
articles.summary: After 241 days in orbit, NASA astronaut Chris Williams is back on Earth. His mission included cancer research, spacewalks, and testing manufacturing techniques that could revolutionize electronics. He landed in Kazakhstan on July 26.

articles.title: Beyond Radio Signals: Why Bread Could Be a Sign of Alien Intelligence
articles.summary: Astrobiologist Julia DeMarines proposes 'noosignatures'—evidence of intelligence that isn't technological. Using Assembly Theory, she argues that bread, requiring multiple steps from farming to baking, could reveal a thinking mind on another world.

articles.title: Half-Million-Year-Old Elephant Bone Reveals Neanderthal Toolmaking Genius
articles.summary: A 500,000-year-old elephant bone hammer found at Boxgrove, England, is Europe's oldest known elephant bone tool. Microscopic analysis shows it was used to sharpen stone tools, highlighting early humans' sophisticated craftsmanship.
